title: Good Morning Forward
text:
Subah 5:30 baje family group me
42 "Good Morning" messages.
Phool, suraj, chidiya, gyaan —
sab aa gaya, bas neend chali gayi. 🌅

title: Typing… Typing… Gone
text:
Wo: typing…
Main: dil ki dhadkan tez.
Wo: typing…
Main: saans rok li.
Wo: "ok"
Do ghante ki mehnat, do akshar ka result. 💬

title: Blue Tick
text:
Duniya ka sabse dardnaak scene:
Message deliver — blue tick.
Status update — online.
Reply — nahi. 💔

title: Group Se Exit
text:
Group me 3 din se koi message nahi aaya.
Maine likha: "Ye group dead hai."
2 second me 87 messages,
aur sabne kaha: "Haan, dead hai." 😂

title: Status Dekhne Wala
text:
Har kisi ke status list me ek banda hota hai
jo har status dekhta hai,
kabhi reply nahi karta,
aur mile toh kehta hai "maine dekha hi nahi." 👀

title: Last Seen Detective
text:
Last seen 11:42 pm.
Mera message 11:40 pm ka.
Matlab dekha, socha, chhoda.
Is se bada case CID bhi solve nahi kar sakti. 🕵️

title: 7 Minute ka Voice Note
text:
Dost ne 7 minute ka voice note bheja.
Maine 2x speed pe suna.
Pata chala pooch raha tha: "Khana kha liya?" 🎙️

title: Forwarded Many Times
text:
Uncle ne message bheja:
"Ye NASA ne confirm kiya hai."
Maine check kiya —
NASA ko khud nahi pata. 🚀

title: Online Hai
text:
Online hai.
Online hai.
Abhi bhi online hai.
Mera message abhi bhi ek tick pe hai.
Internet uska, dard mera. 📶

title: DP Change
text:
Ek DP change karne ke liye
60 photo kheenchi,
14 filter lagaye,
3 dost se poocha,
aur 2 ghante baad wahi purani DP rakh li. 🤳

title: Family Group ka Rule
text:
Family group me koi bhi photo daalo,
mamaji sirf "👍" bhejenge,
buaji 4 paragraph ka ashirwad,
aur ek cousin sirf "kaun hai ye?" 😅

title: Good Night
text:
Raat 2 baje "Good Night" bhejne wale log
ya toh bahut vyast hain,
ya bahut khaali.
Beech ka option hai hi nahi. 🌙

title: Group Admin
text:
Group admin banne ke baad
logon me ek ajeeb confidence aa jata hai.
Jaise poore desh ki policy wahi banate hain. 👑

title: Screenshot
text:
Har message bhejne se pehle ek hi dar:
"Kahin screenshot na le le."
Aur har group me ek banda hota hai
jiska kaam hi screenshot hai. 📸

title: Delete for Everyone
text:
"This message was deleted"
se zyada curiosity
kisi suspense film me nahi hoti. 🔍

title: Sticker War
text:
Ek dost ne sticker bheja.
Maine jawab me sticker bheja.
45 minute tak koi shabd nahi bola gaya,
phir bhi poori baat ho gayi. 🎭
